now: ceiling closed; names reliable only if the list is a tool

cut.trigger: One take file and one region with start and end times; quiet for episode-wide restitch or reorder.
cut.doneWhen: One python3 check script exits 0 printing 'outside-region: N/N samples unchanged' and 'listen: region noted' only if the same take file is kept, only the region is tightened, and a listen note for that region exists; a no-op cut is valid.
cut.forbidden: Restitching the episode: changing, moving, or re-joining anything outside the named region.

names.trigger: A script or transcript and a pronunciation list file are present; no list means report no list and stop.
names.doneWhen: python3 script loads the pronunciation list file itself and exits 0 on every completed run, printing 'missing: <name> line <n>' for each proper noun not on the list (a flag is a valid result, not a failure) and 'names: K/N listed'; empty script prints 'names: 0/0'; an unreadable or absent list prints 'no list' and also exits 0 as a reported result.
names.forbidden: Guessing a pronunciation or spelling for a proper noun not on the list instead of flagging it.

score.trigger: A rule file and existing music assets are present; quiet when asked to compose a new theme.
score.doneWhen: python3 script exits 0 when the hook cue lies inside its rule window using a rule-named asset (prints 'hook: ok') or when the hook is unplaced (prints 'hook: absent', a valid result); exits non-zero only for a placed hook outside its window or using an unnamed asset.
score.forbidden: Composing or generating a new theme to fill the hook, or placing a cue the rule file does not name.

assemble.trigger: An approved-takes list and take files are present; quiet when a take is unapproved or audio regeneration is asked.
assemble.doneWhen: python3 script hashes takes and exits 0 only if exactly the approved takes appear in listed order with unchanged hashes, printing 'assembled: N/N takes'; empty list valid.
assemble.forbidden: Regenerating or re-recording audio to fill a gap or substituting an unapproved take.
assemble.gate: ABSENT accept (prepare the ordered take list and hash report, stop; a person listens and accepts the assembly)
